INIT capacity, cache = CALL orderedDict()

FUNCTION get ACCEPTS(key)
    IF key in cache THEN
        CALL moveToFront(cache, key)
        RETURN cache[key]
    ELSE
        RETURN null

    ENDIF
ENDFUNCTION
FUNCTION put ACCEPTS(key, value)
    IF key in cache THEN
        CALL moveToFront(cache, key)
        cache[key] <- value
    ELSE
        IF LENGTH OF cache == capacity THEN
            CALL removeBack(cache)

        ENDIF
        CALL addToFront(cache, key, value)
    ENDIF
ENDFUNCTION
